About the Gorham Bike & Ski Waterville Wednesday Night Mountain Bike Ride group ride

A no-drop trail ride from the Waterville shop, usually at Quarry Road or Inland Pine Ridge. Twelve to fifteen miles at a moderate pace; if the group splits, it waits. The shop also runs a Thursday 5 pm road ride from the same spot.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
